claim: Let G be a finite forest and x(G) the least k with Delta_k(G) < 0. (LB) For every natural k, Delta_k(G) < 0 implies n <= 4k. (R5) If n >= 21 then Delta_5(G) >= 0. (XR) For every natural r, x(G) < r implies n <= 4r - 4. Here n = Nat.card X and Delta_k is the G1 definition of record. The terminal declaration of this award is (XR); (LB) and (R5) are the other two award faces, registered as lemmas in the same project. All three are unconditional: the degree lemma (DL) is supplied by the carried, kernel-verified Erdos993G1.forest_degree_lemma of award C1-LA1, so no DlHyp hypothesis appears on any face.
